Grade a beginner flexbox task out of 10. index.html is given (class names .menu, .links, .cards, .card, .footer). The student may use the editor's AI agent for colours, shadows and animation; grade the layout rules.
1. (3) .menu: display:flex, justify-content:space-between, align-items:center (1 each) — logo left, links right, vertically centred.
2. (2.5) .cards: display:flex with gap:16px (gap value 16px required for full points; other gap 1.5).
3. (2) .card: display:flex with flex-direction:column (title, text, button stacked).
4. (1.5) .footer content centred horizontally (display:flex + justify-content:center, or text-align:center).
5. (1) Design: at least one hover effect or transition.
Accept the flex rules inside any rule for the same selector; ignore all other CSS written by the agent; do not penalize extra styling.
